key_insight: AI is positioned as a practical framework to understand, predict, and mitigate instability in 3D all-inorganic perovskites (CsPbX3) by linking data-driven analysis with mechanism discovery and engineering design.
engineering_relevance: The review highlights how AI can help improve the durability and reliability of perovskite optoelectronic devices under thermal, chemical, optical, and electrical stress.
method: Consequence/reliability modeling and engineering stability enhancement
evidence_signal: The abstract emphasizes that conventional approaches are limited by multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification challenges, motivating AI-assisted evaluation.
watch_item: A major concern is poor data quality and inconsistent test protocols, which can limit model transferability and benchmark reliability.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
